candidates.concerns_gist: Transfer from Nat Nanotechnol (2 rounds there, not in file). Inductance model confusing (geometric/kinetic/Josephson); single-arm approximation needs Ic2/Ic1>20; pi-phase as chiral TRS-breaking order and Cooper-pair co-tunneling need alternatives ruled out.

candidates.title: Controlled parity of cooper pair tunneling in a hybrid superconducting qubit
candidates.concerns_gist: Transfer; file holds only final sign-off round at Nat Commun (original reports not included). Only remark: exploits known physics, qubit protection not shown. Little usable critique.
flags: transfer: earlier review rounds at another journal are not in the file

candidates.title: Quantum Hall antidot as a fractional coulombmeter
candidates.concerns_gist: Transfer from Nat Nanotechnol (first-round reports not included). Extraction of oscillation period, and hence fractional charge, from conductance maps not systematic or reproducible; significance for Nat Phys; GaAs comparison disputed.
flags: transfer: earlier review rounds at another journal are not in the file
revised arXiv version before 2026-07-01

candidates.title: Boundary-Bulk Interplay in Nonlinear Topological Transport
candidates.concerns_gist: Whether 2w signals need bulk carriers (finite 2w in quantized states), axion-insulator identification without magnetoelectric probe, boundary/bulk symmetrization decomposition, choice of sandwich heterostructure, unexplained figure features.

candidates.title: Orientation-tunable correlated Chern insulating states in chiral twisted double bilayer graphene proximitized by WSe2
candidates.concerns_gist: Alignment-angle SOC (Ising vs Rashba) as driver of topology not separated from sublattice-symmetry breaking or other alignment effects; few devices/angles; correlated insulator robustness at large misalignment; phenomenological continuum model.
flags: v1 posted 153 days after journal submission (received 2026-01-28): may already include first-round revisions

candidates.title: Experimental realization of the topologically nontrivial phase in monolayer Si2Te2
candidates.concerns_gist: Edge in-gap LDOS not unique to QSH (trivial edge states, band bending); small islands, tip convolution, edge hybridization; peaked edge DOS vs linear dispersion; Wannier/Z2 calculation details and substrate effects; promotional wording.

candidates.title: Unveiling the landscape of Mottness and its proximity to superconductivity in 4Hb-TaS2
candidates.concerns_gist: Method for electron filling per Star-of-David cluster; Brinkman-Rice vs Kondo (single impurity vs Kondo lattice) interpretation; proximity superconductivity on 1T surface and competition with paramagnetic puddles not convincing.
flags: v1 posted 108 days after journal submission (received 2025-05-09): may already include first-round revisions

candidates.title: Mixed triplet-singlet order parameter in decoupled superconducting 1H monolayers of transition-metal dichalcogenides
candidates.concerns_gist: Incremental vs 4Hb-TaS2 and monolayer 1H-TaS2; prior misfit literature not credited; singlet-triplet mixing not the only explanation of two gaps; role of superconducting SnS layer in nonlocal probes; vortex-location inconsistency.

candidates.title: Multiple superconducting phases and order-parameter evolution in pressurized UTe2
candidates.concerns_gist: Ruling out singlet pairing when fitting with p-wave BTK; sample-to-sample spectral differences at ambient pressure; pressure result rests on one contact realization; BTK approximations; B2u to B3u assignment overreaches.

candidates.title: Electric field tunable coupling strength and quantum metric hot spots in a moiré flatband superconductor
candidates.concerns_gist: Novelty vs earlier ATQG transport reports and existing theory; chemical-potential extraction for flat vs Dirac bands hard to follow; strength of quantum-geometry contribution to superfluid stiffness.
flags: revised arXiv version before 2026-07-01

candidates.title: Imaging of gate-controlled suppression of superconductivity via the Meissner effect
candidates.concerns_gist: Limited novelty (power dependence, distance decay, hot-spot mechanism already known); single 20 nm Nb film; quenching radius as metric; leakage-current hot-quasiparticle model needs fuller characterization.

candidates.title: Resolving Abrikosov vortex entry in superconducting nanostring resonators via displacement-noise spectroscopy in cavity optomechanics
candidates.concerns_gist: Transfer. Frequency jumps attributed to single vortices only indirectly; entry fields not reproducible between sweeps; magneto-elastic coupling estimates; fit for the journal.
flags: transfer: earlier review rounds at another journal are not in the file

candidates.title: Kinetic inductance of few-layer NbSe2 in the two-dimensional limit
candidates.concerns_gist: 1/d scaling of kinetic inductance seems inconsistent with the claimed clean-to-dirty crossover; reliability of comparison with control resonators.
flags: revised arXiv version before 2026-07-01

candidates.title: Entropy plateaus, combinatorial degeneracy, local moments, and heavy-fermion mass renormalization in magic-angle graphene
candidates.concerns_gist: Transfer; Nat Commun rounds are post-revision. Residual: novelty vs prior compressibility/entropy work, heavy-fermion interpretation partly interpretive, entropy plateaus not clearly visible.
flags: transfer: earlier review rounds at another journal are not in the file

candidates.title: Correlated insulator Moiré bolometer
candidates.concerns_gist: Bolometric heating vs other mechanisms for the nu=+2 photoresponse; IVC order identification from transport alone overstated; detector figures of merit missing.
flags: v1 posted on/after acceptance: v1 already reflects referee changes

candidates.title: Interaction-limited conductivity of twisted bilayer graphene revealed by giant terahertz photoresistance
candidates.concerns_gist: Equating THz photoresistance with resistivity at elevated electron temperature (bolometric assumption); twist-angle determination; different devices across figures; quantitative exclusion of electron-phonon scattering; THz power calibration.
flags: revised arXiv version before 2026-07-01

candidates.title: Gate-imprinted memory and light-induced erasure of superconductivity at KTaO3-based interfaces
candidates.concerns_gist: Polar-nanoregion and oxygen-vacancy mechanism inferred from indirect dielectric-loss correlations; charge trapping, persistent photoconductivity and doping shifts not excluded; novelty vs known gating/optical effects in KTaO3.

candidates.title: Electrically controllable superconducting memory effect in UTe2
candidates.concerns_gist: Intrinsic vs extrinsic (heating, inhomogeneity) origin of the hysteretic memory; RSJ/Josephson analogy; vortex-clustering mechanism and link to two order parameters need strengthening.
flags: v1 posted 84 days after journal submission (received 2025-12-08): may already include first-round revisions
revised arXiv version before 2026-07-01

early_candidates.title: Spin-polarized edge modes between different magnet-superconductor-hybrids
early_candidates.concerns_gist: No direct evidence for topological nodal-point superconductivity (suppressed gap is not topology); single-superconductor tight-binding mapping; novelty.

early_candidates.title: Reentrant superconductivity in a naturally occurring Josephson junction array tuned by radio-frequency power
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Single device in quasi-four-probe geometry; RF heating vs intrinsic reentrance; E_J/E_c interpretation of reentrant superconductivity and SIT.

early_candidates.title: Nonreciprocal superconducting critical currents with normal state field trainability in kagome superconductor CsV3Sb5
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Overlap with prior SDE report in CsV3Sb5 (Le et al. 2024); thermal-cycling and field-training insufficient to establish TRS breaking in CDW; residual field and trapped flux.
flags: revised arXiv version before 2026-07-01

early_candidates.title: Evidence of competing ground states between fractional Chern insulator and antiferromagnetism in moiré MoTe2
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Unclear novelty in heavily studied tMoTe2; antiferromagnetism inferred indirectly (vanishing MCD and Hall); charge-transfer mechanism for re-emergent ferromagnetism.
flags: revised arXiv version before 2026-07-01

early_candidates.title: Cascade of even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states in mixed-stacked multilayer graphene
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Incremental sequel to the authors' trilayer paper; theoretical explanation of even-denominator states confusing; Landau-level assignments.

early_candidates.title: Simultaneous nanoscale imaging of local conductivity and chemical potential in a quantum Hall isospin ferromagnet
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Technique novelty vs separate sMIM and KPFM; reliability of quantitative gap and DOS extraction; extension to moire QH systems.
flags: v1 posted 203 days after journal submission (received 2025-11-15): may already include first-round revisions

early_candidates.title: Higher odd-order nonlinear Hall effect in magnetic topological insulator Mn(Bi1-xSbx)2Te4
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Novelty for Nat Commun; Berry-curvature-multipole model vs extrinsic (thermal, contact) origins of odd harmonics; sample and gate dependence.
flags: v1 posted 238 days after journal submission (received 2025-08-28): may already include first-round revisions

early_candidates.title: Reentrant Landau levels in a Dirac topological insulator
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Only one sample; Dirac model with large g-factor and LK framework fitted to non-1/B oscillations; interpretation of anomalous temperature dependence.

early_candidates.title: Spectral signature of periodic modulation and shifting of pseudogap state in moiré system
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Separating pseudogap from superconductivity; nematicity claim leans on cuprate analogies; strain and inhomogeneity effects.

early_candidates.title: Yin-Yang vortex on UTe2 (011) surface
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Novelty; all four single-component order parameters reproduce Yin-Yang vortex so pairing not discriminated; claims of confirming triplet pairing and d-vector overreach.
flags: revised arXiv version before 2026-07-01

early_candidates.title: Spectroscopic evidence for a first-order transition to a possible orbital Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov state
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Mostly positive; whether hysteresis is intrinsic (vs vortex or flux effects), field-alignment sensitivity, thickness dependence and definitions.

early_candidates.title: Supercurrent effect in a charge density wave intertwined superconductor
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Symmetry lowering under in-plane field may be trivially expected; Doppler-shift (Meissner current) mechanism vs alternatives; presentation of CDW gap.
flags: v1 posted on/after acceptance: v1 already reflects referee changes

early_candidates.title: Quantum coherent manipulation and readout of superconducting vortex states
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Presentation (separate data from theory); vortex-as-qubit interpretation vs alternatives; positioning as a quantum platform.
flags: revised arXiv version before 2026-07-01

early_candidates.title: Imaging the flat bands of magic-angle graphene reshaped by interactions
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Effect of WSe2 tunnel barrier; origin of unexplained 15 meV gap; strength of topological heavy-fermion interpretation.

early_candidates.title: Superballistic flow of viscous electron fluid induced by edge magnetoplasmons in point contacts
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Hard to follow writing; how microwave-excited edge magnetoplasmons enhance e-e scattering; reliability of the setup (heating, bolometric artefacts).

early_candidates.title: Family of magnetic field-boosted superconductors in rhombohedral graphene
early_candidates.concerns_gist: Novelty vs prior rhombohedral graphene superconductivity; strength of evidence for unconventional pairing (Pauli violation, field enhancement); seen as preliminary by one referee.
